method: USGS NLDI NHDPlusV2 upstream-mainstem and downstream-mainstem navigation: 12 km upstream and 12 km downstream per eligible gage
interpretation: Colored lines are gage-supported corridors for visualization; they do not represent modeled flood inundation.

method: Maximum flood screening return period among supporting USGS gages
interpretation: Screening estimate from the existing annual-peak pipeline, not a formal Bulletin 17C flood-frequency result.

method: Distinct matched rainfall–flood events with return period ≥10 years
interpretation: One event is counted once per reach even if multiple supporting gages matched the event.

method: AORC HUC-12 maximum rolling 24-hour accumulation from the existing event catalog
interpretation: Average intensity is rolling accumulation divided by duration; it is not an instantaneous rainfall rate.

method: Join each matched gage event to rainfall in the gage's HUC-12
interpretation: Spatial-temporal correspondence only; antecedent wetness, routing, regulation, and other controls remain important.
